title: olea europaea subsp. sativa
intro: Olea europaea subsp. sativa, commonly known as the sweet or green olive tree, is a subspecies of the olive tree (Olea europaea) that is primarily cultivated for its edible fruit. The health benefits of Olea europaea subsp. sativa include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high levels of antioxidants and polyphenols. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as arthritis, infections, and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Olea europaea subsp. sativa include oleuropein, hydroxytyrosol, and tyrosol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
